tooltip.nomadic_herbs.grinder.tooltip: Grinds plants into pastes or powders.
tooltip.nomadic_herbs.pouch.tooltip: A small, light pouch that can hold water when filled.
tooltip.nomadic_herbs.water_pouch.toolti: A small, light pouch holding a few sips of water.
tooltip.nomadic_herbs.peyote.tooltip: Can be ground into a healing paste with a Grinder.
tooltip.nomadic_herbs.peyote_paste.toolt: Treats basic open wounds and infections.
tooltip.nomadic_herbs.rosemary.tooltip: Eaten to ease muscle discomfort and easier digestion.
tooltip.nomadic_herbs.cilantro.tooltip: Relieves stomach pains and general aches.
tooltip.nomadic_herbs.water_hyssop.toolt: Lowers stress levels and anxiety, whilst also improving digestion.
tooltip.nomadic_herbs.squirreltail.toolt: Reduces fever and soothes rashes or burning sensations.
When applied, this paste treats boils from the hot sun.
tooltip.nomadic_herbs.artemisia.tooltip: Soothes the nerves of stressed cats.
tooltip.nomadic_herbs.thyme.tooltip: Soothes grief and respiratory issues, along with sore throats when eaten with honey.
tooltip.nomadic_herbs.basil.tooltip: Reduces stress whilst aiding in fighting off infection.
tooltip.nomadic_herbs.sundew_mucilage.to: A sticky substance that can be used to pull away old wrappings and debris near a wound.

tooltip.nomadic_herbs.shredded_bitter_le: Aids in slumber, anxiety and can numb areas when applied topically.
tooltip.nomadic_herbs.bitter_lettuce.too: Can be shredded into bits for topical use.
tooltip.nomadic_herbs.prickly_pear_paste: Aids in relieving pain or inflammation.

tooltip.nomadic_herbs.creosote_cluster.t: Helps treat burns, wounds and infection; alongside also aiding in pulling out toxins from the stomach.
tooltip.nomadic_herbs.brittlebush_cluste: Soothes toothaches, general pains, and clears up sinuses.

tooltip.nomadic_herbs.jaborandi.tooltip: Assists cats with failing vision or other eye problems.

tooltip.nomadic_herbs.milkweed.tooltip: Can be seperated into petals and stems by right-clicking.
tooltip.nomadic_herbs.milkweed_stems.too: Helps soothe grief and provides strength.
tooltip.nomadic_herbs.sweet_flag.tooltip: Eases anxiety and can assist against general coughs and respiratory illness; can also help against stomach aches.

tooltip.nomadic_herbs.cardinal_flower_pe: A very strong, general treatment against illnesses; however can also be used to put down cats with Desert Delirium.

tooltip.nomadic_herbs.epherdra.tooltip: A general herb used against fevers and burns.
tooltip.nomadic_herbs.aloe.tooltip: Cools and soothes deep burns and rashes.
tooltip.nomadic_herbs.spearmint.tooltip: Soothes aching joints and general pains, or used to fight off nausea or flea bites.
tooltip.nomadic_herbs.lavender.tooltip: Used for soothing clogged respiratory systems, easing grief or panic, staunching blood and easing minor wounds.
tooltip.nomadic_herbs.aloysia.tooltip: Eases cats into a sleep by calming nerves; can also bring down fevers.
